an-1.1.summary: The waiting label setting and its writes (was rc-22.3). See AN1.1; §D28.
acceptance: Fake-GitHub tests: the label is on the gate and its gate-only dependents, off a dependent that has another unmet blocker, kept on failed and unknown, removed on done, and written once across three ticks; a label equal to another managed label is refused naming both; the UI test shows the field with its default.

an-1.2.summary: Needs you row and the person's clear as an order (was rc-22.4). See AN1.2; §D28.
acceptance: Fake tests: a failed gate gives one row across three ticks and releases nothing; an allowed clear releases the dependent and is not counted as verified completion; a stranger's clear is reverted; a later `done` adds evidence only; a second clear records nothing new.

an-1.3.summary: Gate rows in Release queue, Trace and Waiting on you, plus the CLI and MCP reads (was rc-22.5). See AN1.3; §D28.
acceptance: The UI test renders an open, a failed and a cleared gate and checks the fields and the Waiting on you filter at 320 px; the CLI read matches the page; `node scripts/release-scan.mjs` is clean.

an-p1.summary: Proof: a gate with a fake plugin. See AN1.4; §D28.
acceptance: Expected result observed with the fake plugin; receipt under `docs/evidence/`.

an-2.1.summary: `mirror` setting: form and raw `.avoozl.json`, private-only validation. See AN2.1; §D29.
acceptance: A public or unreadable mirror is refused; `forward: auto` with no trusted person is refused; the form and the raw file agree after an edit in either; `npm test` passes.

an-2.2.summary: Sync step and write targets. See AN2.1; §D29.
acceptance: A fake GitHub test: a fast-forward is applied, a divergence gives one row across three ticks and no write to either branch, no call writes to the source except the forward path.

an-2.3.summary: Track merged mirror PRs, rows and Trace steps. See AN2.1; §D29.
acceptance: A merge in the mirror gives one record across repeated ticks and the four Trace steps appear in order with GitHub times.

an-2.4.summary: Forward: one commit, strip, scan, push, public PR; nudge and auto. See AN2.1; §D29.
acceptance: Tests: a clean change forwards once; a planted private term blocks the push with one row naming the rule; `auto` forwards for a trusted approver and not for another; a second press opens no second PR; no force push is ever issued.

an-2.5.summary: Public poll: done on public merge, closed unmerged, review copy-back. See AN2.1; §D29.
acceptance: A fake GitHub test: a mirror merge alone releases no dependent; the public merge releases them; a close returns the row; a comment copies once across three ticks.

an-2.6.summary: Conflicts: sync, re-apply, then a mirror issue for a crew. See AN2.1; §D29.
acceptance: A fake GitHub test: a moved source applies on retry; a true conflict opens one issue with paths and no contents.

an-p2.summary: Proof: the mirror flow with a fake GitHub. See AN2.2; §D29.
acceptance: Expected result observed with the fake GitHub; receipt under `docs/evidence/`. The run on two real scratch repositories is an owner step.

an-3.1.summary: Hook command: scan a crew's writes before they run. See AN3.1; §6.14.
acceptance: `avoozl content hook` refuses a gh or git write that holds a rule match or text it cannot read, naming the rule set, id and place and never the text.

an-3.2.summary: Audit on the tick: delete a hit, pull the cord, alert. See AN3.1; §6.14.
acceptance: The tick deletes a matching crew comment, closes a matching pull request, pulls the cord for the repository, and sends one notice and one Needs you item.

an-3.3.summary: Public crew checklist, sign-off and handoff gate. See AN3.1; §6.14.
acceptance: A person signs off the checklist; a public repository is handed to Issue Radar only with a current sign-off, which lapses when a hashed item changes.
One person-only action pulls the cord for every public repository with a crew and lists the crews to pause.

an-3.5.summary: Public docs and the upstream requests. See AN3.1; §6.14.
acceptance: `docs/public-crews.md` states the limits in generic terms and drafts the Kiro Crew requests without filing them.

an-p3.summary: Proof: a public crew's leak is stopped, deleted and alerted. See AN3.2; §6.14.
acceptance: Expected result observed; receipt under `docs/evidence/`.

an-4.1.summary: Proof P38: the Specs name and ideas. See AN4.1; §8.7, §8.8.
acceptance: The named test passes and a receipt under `docs/evidence/` records setup, action, observation and verdict.

an-4.2.summary: Proof P39: pull the Andon cord. See AN4.1; §4.11.
acceptance: The named test passes and a receipt under `docs/evidence/` records the run.

an-4.3.summary: Proof P42: add the Share steps 13 and 14. See AN4.2; §4.18, R28.9.
acceptance: The extended test passes; the receipt names steps 13 and 14.

an-4.4.summary: Proof P43: activity log. See AN4.1; §4.19.
acceptance: The named test passes and a receipt under `docs/evidence/` records the run.
